notes.title: Playtest update 0.1.9 - Room
notes.notes:
[p]Hello! I've been preparing this update to show the new Lobby so hope you like it! And of course a lot of fixes and changes too.


[b]------------------------------------------- CHANGES -------------------------------------------[/b] [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Balance enemies, damage, and health, especially at the beginning of the game.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Balancing enemy spawns so that higher-level enemies cannot appear and it is unfair due to the difference in stats. The enemy level starts at 0 and, unless modified by a tile effect, this value will only increase as you progress through the map, increasing the enemy pool and therefore the difficulty.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Changes in how selections work. chests, shops, leveling up,twilights. Previously, it was a fixed value that only changed with Tile effects. This could be a bit inconsistent, so to place greater emphasis on risk reward, the number of selections will be modified by the size of the map.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fix hover enemies pause unpause. When the player hovers an enemy the combat continues that makes it hard to follow. Now when an enemy is hover the combat pauses.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fix some description texts.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Standard magic ability stamina points changed from 3 to 2.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Input actions bug fixed. On Change scene to back to the lobby the inputs crash and throw errors, now when the scene is changed it clear all input events first.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Item IDs bug fixed. There where some items without IDs, now all the Items have an ID and another ID for the specific lists that help to check items in the code.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]------------------------------------------- NEW -------------------------------------------[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New lobby sprites room implemented.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]New menu where the player can check all items from the game. Try and Unlock all :).[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Now the actions info from the Lobby room have texts to remark what button is neccesary and if it is hold or press action.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Change background combat to be more clear when enemies sprites are too darker and was difficult to see at combat.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added new feedback form at start. A google form where you can send feedback about what do you think. It helps a lot![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Little animation on Menu that follow the mouse in a radius, I think it gives a cool 3D effect :)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Again thanks all for play the Playtest, it helps a lot to know what you think about the actual state of game.[/p][p][/p][p]The game is still in an early version but I will keep updating and adding content so hope you keep playing it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635808/ec739795a7efb629a1d2d968bb14c54ee16676a0.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Make your Move - Update Alpha v0.1.7
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][b]------------ DEVLOG: UPDATE INFO PANELS --------------[/b][/p][p]Hello all! Here is the first patch, I have been doing some minor fixes and remaking the info panel system at all. 
[/p][p][b]------------ CHANGELOG --------------[/b][/p][list][*][p]Audio: Some sfx has been added when the tiles are show in the top panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Texts: Fixed a lot of item descriptions that had errors or missplaced in game.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies: Stats balance in enemies level 1 because it can appears at early and could kill the player without possibility to contest.[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities: Mage Thunder ability had an error that only target 1 enemy now it fixed to 2 targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Info system: Major update, the system has been changed at all, now is full responsive, all the info is available on hover (like effects description) and how is placed in the panel has changed too to be more clear to read. Any feedback is welcome 👍[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks all that have download and play Make your Move. If you have any feedback feel free to enter [/p][p]Discord Server [url="https://discord.gg/VG6M5VKx"]https://discord.gg/VG6M5VKx[/url] or use the comments 😊​[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635808/ec739795a7efb629a1d2d968bb14c54ee16676a0.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Make your Move Playtest version alpha 0.1.6 OPEN!
notes.notes: [p][b]------------ PLAYTEST ALPHA VERSION 0.1.6 --------------[/b][/p][p]Hello all! After a lot of time I have been able to prepare a playable version of Make your Move, it will be update with new version as the development continues. The idea is to get feedback about the gameplay. So hope you enjoy it 🙂![/p][p][b]------------ WHAT IS INCLUDED --------------[/b][/p][list][*][p]Scenes: Main menu, Lobby and Game.[/p][/*][*][p]Language: English.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial panels.[/p][/*][*][p]Save/Load system.[/p][/*][*][p]Map generation. (Only 1 loop playable every Run).[/p][/*][*][p]Void Deck. Where player can store new Tiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Player levels and enemy levels (Twilight).[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock equipment stats system.[/p][/*][*][p]Buy/Sell system.[/p][/*][*][p]Seed RNG system. (Only to read in case of find bugs to report).[/p][/*][*][p]Original game themes. (Menu, Lobby/Run and Combat).[/p][/*][*][p]Duration estimated: Around 15 - 20 min to finish a Run.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]------------ GAMEPLAY CONTENT --------------[/b][/p][list][*][p]15 different player stats.[/p][/*][*][p]5 types of shards. Game money used to buy items.[/p][/*][*][p]45 equipment items.[/p][/*][*][p]16 types of potions.[/p][/*][*][p]2 classes. Each one with 5 unique abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]30 different Tiles. 10 basic Tiles that can be combine by 2 or 4 in this version. Each one with a different effect.[/p][/*][*][p]3 types of Chunk sizes. 2x2x2, 3x3x3 and 4x4x4.[/p][/*][*][p]15 variant of enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]10 Twilight effects that increase enemy stats.[/p][/*][*][p]4 Debuff effects in combat.[/p][/*][/list][p]Again thanks you all to give an opportunite![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635808/ec739795a7efb629a1d2d968bb14c54ee16676a0.gif"][/img][/p]
